Results Online revenue 3.2x Cost per new customer -38% Revenue from email 34% Client Vinda Industry Outdoor clothing Duration 8 months Services Paid ads Email and lifecycle The problem Vinda’s ads were spending €18,000 a month and bringing in customers who bought one discounted item and never came back. The account was set to win clicks, so it did: mostly from people searching for cheap jackets. Email was a newsletter sent when someone had time. No welcome series, no cart reminders, nothing after a purchase. What we did We rebuilt the ad account around full-price products and set bidding against margin, not revenue.
